# ISyrupWithdrawalManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/syrup/ISyrupWithdrawalManager.sol)

**Title:**
ISyrupWithdrawalManager

Interface for the legacy Maple Syrup withdrawal manager


## Functions
### requestIds

Returns the active withdrawal request id for an owner


```solidity
function requestIds(address owner_) external view returns (uint128);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner_`|`address`|The account to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint128`|The request id|


### requests

Returns the withdrawal request data for a request id


```solidity
function requests(uint128 requestId_) external view returns (WithdrawalRequest memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId_`|`uint128`|The withdrawal request id|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`WithdrawalRequest`|The withdrawal request data|
